# jsonnet_code (Data Source)

Evaluates the provided code string as Jsonnet

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    jsonnet = {
      source = "marcbran/jsonnet"
    }
  }
}

data "jsonnet_code" "example" {
  code = <<EOF
local input = 1;
local output = input + 1;
output
EOF
}

output "result" {
  value = data.jsonnet_code.example.output
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) The Jsonnet code to be evaluated

### Optional

- `options` (Attributes) Additional options to be passed to the Jsonnet command (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--options))

### Read-Only

- `output` (String) The evaluated Jsonnet, as a string

<a id="nestedatt--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options`

Optional:

- `jpaths` (List of String)
